chapter: Art Hodes, Bechet and Blue Note
title: Early 1940s: the Playhouse
summary: Brief stint at the Playhouse near the Savoy site in the early 1940s.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: All right. Nevertheless, you played with At Johnson, and you stayed with him a little while. And you eventually did go back, I guess, to the Victoria again. This was just before the War. Now, during the early years of the Forties, say, around '40, '41, '42, what were you doing? Were you just gigging around? Or did you stay at the Victoria?

Well, I went over to a place called... Right there, there's... I think they've got a playground there or something right across the street. Right across the street from not the Savoy, but... They called it the Playhouse.

Right across the street where we used to work, from the Savoy... There's a playground there or something there now. They call it... They had a club down there they called... But that was only a short while, about three weeks down over there.
